response.original_title: Jess Elgene: Less of a Man
response.overview: Jess Elgene's debut special, LESS OF A MAN, was recorded live at Caveat in New York City on March 6, 2024 and features the original songs "Katarina," "Food Court," "Body // Feelings," "The Devil," "Small Talk," and "Undeniably." The special covers a range of topics including gender identity, body image, and acceptance. Elgene is "totally charismatic and engrossing," and LESS OF A MAN boasts "some of the very best of storytelling-comedy at the Fringe this year." -- Binge Fringe Magazine
